task.title: Add safe task fetch/push and optional pre-push publishing
task.description: Prove two-person collaboration through explicit origin-only synchronization. Add workbook fetch to download refs/workbook/tasks/* into isolated refs/workbook/remotes/origin/tasks/*, validate fetched data, and create or fast-forward compatible local refs while preserving/reporting divergence. Add workbook push to publish all local task refs without force or deletion, report partial success, and reject non-fast-forward updates. Add idempotent workbook hooks install for an opt-in recursion-safe pre-push hook that publishes tasks before code pushes, blocks on failure, and refuses to overwrite non-Workbook hooks with manual chaining guidance. Keep reconciliation, claims, automatic fetch, sync, daemons, pruning, and multiple remotes out of scope; document multiple named remotes as future work. Test with temporary bare remotes and two clones, including corrupt-remote isolation, divergence, partial rejection, and hook safety.
